# Fitness Made Simple SG

> 1-on-1 online personal training for busy professionals in Singapore. Custom programming, live coaching calls, and weekly check-ins — no cookie-cutter plans, zero gym intimidation.

Fitness Made Simple SG is an independent personal training business run by a single coach with 10+ years of hands-on training experience and real client coaching experience across ages 17 to 40+, currently completing NCSF certification (expected October 2026). Coaching is available both online (remote) and in person.

## Pricing
- Online Coaching: $200/month — 30-minute live intro call, custom training program with exercise video demos, weekly check-in (workout log + progress photos), priority messaging support between check-ins, and a live call every two weeks
- External Training: $80/session, sold in packages of 10/20/30/40 sessions (larger packages include free bonus sessions) — 1-on-1 in-person training at an ActiveSG gym or the client's condo gym

## Pages
- [Home](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/): overview, pricing, and a short contact form
- [FAQ](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/faq): answers to common questions about training, pricing tiers, experience level, injuries, and how sessions work
- [Get Started](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/start): full intake form for people ready to begin training
- [Blog](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/blog/): notes on training and coaching
